column1: # Pages a volume index does not reach. R9's shape — declared, or it is a
# finding — but a declaration here is NOT an exemption. Most of these are
# unfinished chapters, and an unfinished chapter is work, not noise: it gets
# finished, tagged, and linked from its volume index.
# tools/chapter_links.py reads this file and sorts the three cases:
#   unfinished  — a chapter being written. REPORTED as backlog, every run,
#                 until it is finished and linked. This is the to-do list.
#   working     — a working page that is not a chapter and never will be.
#   instrument  — output of a tool, lives beside its producer. Suppressed.
# Anything not listed here is an undeclared orphan and fails the gate.
# The script also reports a declaration whose page IS now linked, so the file
# cannot rot: two entries were wrong within a minute of being written.
